children: ICICI Securities's research report on Aadhar Housing Finance

Aadhar Housing Finance (Aadhar) delivered a strong core operating performance, with robust 22%/20% YoY disbursements/AUM growth (adjusted for disbursement policy change in Q1FY27). While reported AUM growth (18.5% YoY) appeared soft due to an accounting shift in the recognition policy, the underlying momentum remains intact, supported by geographically diversified branch network that mitigates single-state concentration risk. Backed by industryfirst market segmentation across urban (focused on scale) and emerging (focus on yields), alongside a strong underwriting policy (~25bps credit cost cross-cycle), management reaffirmed its guidance of 20% YoY AUM growth and >20% YoY disbursements growth for FY27.
Maintain BUY; TP unchanged at INR 625, valuing the stock at ~2.8x Sep’27E BVPS.
